suites.description: Exercise a CAN bus between the unit under test and the lab host. A sender installed on the unit emits an incrementing counter; the lab host receives from socketcan and records gaps and reordering.

suites.description: Install a throughput probe on the unit under test and host a TCP server lab-side. Each tick times an upload and a download; the verdict gates on session-average throughput in each direction.

profiles_available.description: Eight-hour session with per-tick floors and a session-average gate.
profiles_available.name: endurance.yaml

profiles_available.description: No unit required. What `gauntlet verify --run` executes.
profiles_available.name: mock.yaml

profiles_available.description: Two-minute check over a gigabit link.
profiles_available.name: smoke.yaml

suites.description: A worked example of the common shape: sample something on a fixed cadence, fail iterations that breach a threshold, and roll the run up into a verdict. Copy this directory as the starting point for a Python suite.

profiles_available.description: Two-second smoke run. Used by `gauntlet verify --run`; needs no hardware.
profiles_available.name: quick.yaml

profiles_available.description: Five-minute sampled run at 1 Hz.

profiles_available.name: strict.yaml

suites.title: Example — Sampled Loop

suites.description: The same contract satisfied by a bash script with no Gauntlet library at all. Proof that conforming means writing the right files, not importing anything. Start here for a suite in a language other than Python.

profiles_available.description: Fails on iteration 3, to exercise the failure path end to end.
profiles_available.name: failing.yaml

profiles_available.description: Three fast iterations. Used by `gauntlet verify --run`.

profiles_available.description: Twenty iterations at 1 Hz.
profiles_available.name: standard.yaml

suites.title: Example — Shell Script

suites.description: Drive a GPIO trigger line on the unit under test over SSH, one high/low pulse per iteration, and record where it stops responding. Also samples load, memory and disk on the unit between pulses.

profiles_available.description: Long session — 3600 pulses with a one-second gap, ~2 hours.
profiles_available.name: endurance.yaml

profiles_available.description: No unit required. What `gauntlet verify --run` executes.
profiles_available.name: mock.yaml

profiles_available.description: Five pulses against a real unit. Quick check that the line responds.
profiles_available.name: smoke.yaml

suites.title: Hardware Trigger

suites.description: Cycle one or more piezo axes between a home and an extended position over MQTT, recording position, temperature and controller fault flags at the loaded endpoint.

profiles_available.description: Two thousand cycles with a temperature ceiling.
profiles_available.name: endurance.yaml

profiles_available.description: No controller required. What `gauntlet verify --run` executes.
profiles_available.name: mock.yaml

profiles_available.description: Ten cycles on one axis. Quick check that motion and telemetry work.
profiles_available.name: smoke.yaml

suites.title: Piezo Motion

suites.description: Exercise an RS422 serial link to the unit under test. The lab side sends ENQ probes and reads the counter replies, recording gaps and reordering against the expected sequence.

profiles_available.description: Four-hour link session. Allows a small loss budget.
profiles_available.name: endurance.yaml

profiles_available.description: No serial hardware required. What `gauntlet verify --run` executes.
profiles_available.name: mock.yaml

profiles_available.description: One minute at 100 Hz over an auto-detected FTDI adapter.
profiles_available.name: smoke.yaml

suites.title: RS422 Link

suites.description: Probe one or more SSDs on the unit under test. Each tick measures write and read bandwidth with dd, verifies a written block with a SHA-256 compare, and reads SMART error counters.

profiles_available.description: For a unit with an unmounted disk. Formats and mounts it first, then installs the probe. Formatting destroys the contents of `provision.device`.

profiles_available.description: Eight-hour session at 30-second ticks with bandwidth floors.

profiles_available.description: No unit required. What `gauntlet verify --run` executes.

profiles_available.description: Three synthetic units. Exercises the concurrent fan-out with no hardware.

profiles_available.description: Four units probed concurrently, eight hours. Every unit must pass.

profiles_available.description: Two-minute check against a mounted NVMe disk.
